title: Richmond National IT governance and control RACI — August 15, 2026
adds: More than a server host, less than a technology sovereign: Richmond is the principal shared-technology corporate host and a national-contract execution node inside a federated constitution (ITOC sets policy; FRFS/CPE owns payment-product requirements; Board/RBOPS hold budget and capital gates; each Bank stays legally accountable). Defensible wording: 'Richmond-centered shared technology governance inside a twelve-Bank federal enterprise.'
